featured_reviews.name: Anna Dsouza
featured_reviews.review_text:
This is a heartfelt post to the heroes of our streets—the stray dogs who watch over us with that quiet, intuitive loyalty—and to the HUMANS who bridge our worlds with compassion
… to those wagging tails that sense kindness from a mile away, the barks that echo like guardians of the night, and the way they repay love with unwavering devotion.

It's a reminder that communication isn't just words; it's in the shared glances, the gentle pats, and the trust built one paw-print at a time.
... but so often we fail to understand them ... every now and then we hear of strays being mentioned for the wrong reasons, but then there are those times when they come to the rescue and more than often go unnoticed, unacknowledged and forgotten ... with their sixth sense they guard the streets for they know who's not welcome and they know whom they should protect!

Best is they know how to return LOVE ...
… to the HUMANS …

I'm so glad places like Heads Up for tails ” in Chembur exist to educate us on the real needs of our pets and strays included.

Pranay Kadam , the Store manager of HUFT , Chembur is an exceptional professional.

His commitment to customers  comes thru in every single action

He has educated me on  host of things and delivered products,  ever so politely.

Very important for me is my time and he helps me manage my time by quick response time to messages and calls, grasping things at the get go and honoring his word.

Its a pleasure to interact  with Pranay . He is a great asset to orgs he works for

I would not give as much business to this store if it wasnt for Pranays top notch service.

Afterall, we all share this one planet we have!

This is when we are reminded, we humans can make the world better for all who share it.

Regards,
Smita Das
(Chembur, Mumbai)

What is even more concerning is that I was NOT informed about this incident by the owner or staff. I discovered the injury later myself. Hiding such an incident from a pet owner is completely unacceptable and shows a serious lack of responsibility and transparency.

💥 WARNING:
Once you bring your fur angel back home, be ready to convince them that you are still their real parents — not Manisha Ma’am! 😂

Thank you from the bottom of our hearts to Manisha Ma’am, her wonderful mom, and her sister for treating Sweety like family. We’re so grateful — you’ve earned our trust for life!
